title: I made my first game (another action rogue-like) please play it!
author: rsgraeme
selftext:
itch link to the game:

[https://geddqt.itch.io/skeleton-mob-club](https://geddqt.itch.io/skeleton-mob-club)



I built my first ever game in Godot with Claude using mostly free and some paid assets from itch.io. No prior game dev experience so kind of guessing my way through it.



The core game is just fighting monsters, collecting cards and getting stronger. Among the \~77 cards, you can get "elemental" cards that when collected (2 different base elements) allow you to discover the combined elemental card (Fire + Air = Lightning).  I recommend playing on a controller (I used an xbox controller in playtests)



Not sure if I want to "finish" it or what exactly I want to do with the game. Would love some feedback.
